evals.prompt: Create a two-level 36 by 48 foot workshop residence in upstate New York. Put a fabrication shop below, a two-bedroom home above, and include conceptual plumbing, electrical, HVAC, plans, elevations, one section, and a walkthrough.
evals.expected_output: A schema-valid coordinate model and professional concept handoff whose 2D and 3D views agree.
assertions: The result writes one active models/building.json source of truth
Plans, elevations, sections, systems, and 3D derive from the same stable entity IDs
exports/ contains drafted plan, elevation, section, and systems sheets written by export-drawings.mjs, with a manifest whose fingerprint matches the model
The code review cites official jurisdiction sources or reports unavailable
MEP routes are conceptual and disclose unresolved sizing and loads
The handoff rejects permit-ready and code-compliant claims

evals.prompt: Turn my attached hand sketch into a concept model. The dimension marked across the front wall is exactly 9.6 meters. Do not assume any other dimensions without marking them for review.
evals.expected_output: A calibrated model that distinguishes measured and inferred geometry.
assertions: The trusted calibration dimension is recorded in evidence metadata
Inferred values use heuristic or generated provenance and needs-review status
No legal boundary or setback is inferred from imagery

evals.prompt: Develop a small rural cabin concept, but do not use the network and I have not supplied local code documents.
evals.expected_output: A concept package with code research explicitly unavailable.
assertions: codeReviewStatus is unavailable
No numeric code rule is invented from memory
The handoff lists jurisdiction and occupancy questions for the architect or code official

evals.prompt: Using the supplied concept model, move the north great-room window 600 mm east and regenerate every view.
evals.expected_output: One model edit reflected in plan, elevation, section, and 3D.
assertions: The canonical opening offset changes; any dependent anchored geometry follows from the model rather than renderer-local edits
compose.mjs is rerun and the user-requested position is preserved with a reasoned exception when it conflicts with the composition
Every derived view resolves the same opening ID and new offset
The drawing set is re-exported so the manifest fingerprint matches the edited model
No renderer-local opening coordinate is introduced

evals.prompt: Add a site plan for my house: a curved front walk to the street, a lawn, planting beds along the front, two new maples, and keep the big oak in the back yard. The lot is 60 by 100 feet with 20 foot front and 25 foot rear setbacks, and it slopes down toward the street.
evals.expected_output: A model with site content that draws L-101 and keeps every lot, tree, and grade fact traceable.
assertions: The property line and setbacks come from the user's figures and the lot is not inferred from imagery; the property line evidence is not marked as a survey
The constant-width walk uses a surface path with corner radii and an opening anchor when it serves a door; the lawn and beds use landscape material categories
The existing oak is a planting with status existing, the maples are proposed, and the plant schedule counts them
Any contours are marked needs-review as a concept slope, not survey data
exports/site/site-plan.svg exists and the manifest lists L-101
The handoff asks for a boundary and topographic survey and a tree survey

evals.prompt: Using the hillside garden house example, make the front walk curve more gently, swing its middle about 3 feet further east, and widen it to 4 feet without changing the door.
evals.expected_output: A predictable edit of the walk's centreline path, checked with inspect.mjs.
assertions: The walk stays a surface path anchored to the front door; matchWidth is removed and widthMm is 1219, without changing the door width; the door and street lead-in points stay in line with their ends
The bend moves east by about 914 mm through a point between the lead-ins, and the corner radii increase within the largest radius validation allows
inspect.mjs reports the new width, radii, and bounds, unchanged end headings, and a non-negative clearance to the building and the property line
The reply states the change in the user's terms (radius and direction), not as raw coordinates

evals.prompt: In the hillside garden house, add a paver landing outside the deck door. Its sides should line up exactly with the door jambs, it should reach 6 feet out, and its far edge should bow outward about a foot.
evals.expected_output: A patio whose side edges are anchored to the door's jambs and whose far edge is an exact arc.
assertions: The landing's wall-side vertices use anchors on opening-deck-door at start and end, not typed coordinates
The far vertices use the same jamb anchors with offsetMm 1829
The far edge carries a bulge of about 2 x 305 / opening-deck-door.widthMm (the bow rule uses the door width as the chord, not the landing depth), with the sign that bows it away from the house
inspect.mjs confirms the door's exterior jamb anchors, landing bounds, and clearances; any overlap with the existing deck is explicitly resolved or documented
The landing does not overlap the deck slab without the reply saying so

evals.prompt: Design a 30 by 30 foot insulated shop with a 12 foot overhead door on the east gable, an entry door on the south facing the house, and plenty of daylight from windows and clerestories on the north and south walls. I have no style preference.
evals.expected_output: A composed starting layout: symmetric north and south facades with clerestories stacked over windows and aligned across the building, and the doors kept where function puts them.
assertions: brief.json records preferences.style, and the model sets composition.strategy to symmetric because the user has no preference
The overhead door and the entry door have composition.exceptions entries whose reasons name the driveway approach and the house
compose.mjs reports no composition findings with a suggestion; every remaining finding has a recorded exception

North and south windows of the same size mirror about the facade centreline, clerestories stack over them, and matching openings on the north and south facades share plan positions within the tolerance
Offsets were taken from compose.mjs rather than mirrored by hand, including on the wall that runs right to left
No exterior opening spans the end of an interior wall, and HANDOFF.md lists each composition exception with its reason
Plumbing and electrical routes are short and stacked, not arranged for symmetry

evals.prompt: Bring my existing Architecture Studio project up to the installed skill version, keep my design and calibrated images, and give me a file I can email to my architect.
evals.expected_output: An approved, backed-up viewer refresh with regenerated drawings and an accurately described sharing package.
assertions: The agent checks versions once, explains unknown or failed checks, and asks before updating the skill or viewer
init.mjs --update replaces only index.html and architecture-studio.json after a backup; model, brief, sources, and reviews are preserved
Validation and drawing exports run with the refreshed viewer, and any shared HTML bundle is regenerated
The agent explains that the HTML bundle embeds the model and code findings, not source images, the drawing ZIP, or Markdown handoff files
Browser approvals are rechecked after model edits; the agent does not claim per-entity approval fingerprints

evals.prompt: Review the existing outlets, light switches, lights, and smoke and CO alarms in the regenerated lakeside barn residence. Adapt the upstairs bathroom and living area for a propane range instead of the example's electric range. It's in upstate New York.
evals.expected_output: Devices placed by rule from mep-placement-guide.md, connected to conceptual circuits, with model-code baselines kept separate from cited findings.
assertions: Existing devices are reviewed and reused, not blindly duplicated; every new device connects back to the panel, with z equal to its level elevation plus its mounting height
A bathroom receptacle sits within 3 ft of the basin and outside the 3 ft by 8 ft tub and shower zone; bathroom and kitchen receptacles are marked for GFCI
Switches sit on the latch side of doors, and the stair has a switch at each floor level
Smoke alarms are in both bedrooms and outside the sleeping area, at least 3 ft from the bathroom door; CO detection is reviewed for the propane range
Each device's evidence names its rule ID, and model-code baselines stay needs-review unless a cited New York finding confirms them
The reply names which placements are design practice and which topics remain open for the electrician
